name: Md. Asadozzaman
intro: I connect computer vision models, evaluation, and software into practical AI systems. My work spans 5+ years of applied AI and backend engineering.
experience: At Tau Research Limited, I contribute to applied computer vision and the software around it: model integration, backend applications, and cloud workflows. Working across these layers has shaped how I approach reliability, validation, and maintainable systems.

projects.label: VIDEO INTELLIGENCE
projects.title: From video frames to inspectable results.
projects.name: Production Video Analytics
projects.summary: A modular YOLO + ByteTrack pipeline that turns video into annotated output, track observations, and a reproducible run summary.
projects.boundary: Counting and accuracy evaluation are future milestones.

projects.label: ANNOTATION INTEGRITY
projects.title: Trust the annotations. Check the round trip.
projects.name: CVAT Annotation Round Trip
projects.summary: A programmatic CVAT experiment that exports and re-imports a video track, then checks its geometry, timing, and frame alignment.
projects.boundary: One synthetic video and one rectangle track.

projects.label: LLM EVALUATION
projects.title: Make RAG answers easier to evaluate.
projects.name: CLEAR-RAG
projects.summary: An evaluation application bringing together retrieval metrics, model-based judging, human review, and experiment comparison.
projects.boundary: Evaluation workflows do not establish deployment readiness.

projects.label: AI APPLICATION ENGINEERING
projects.title: Give database questions a clear context.
projects.name: Database Chat Assistant
projects.summary: A database chat MVP with schema discovery, lexical retrieval, foreign-key relationships, SQL validation, and query history.
projects.boundary: A local demonstration; production security needs further work.
